summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting quarterly financial results (Item 2.02) and a routine quarterly dividend declaration of $0.0025 per share (Item 8.01). The press release and investor presentation discuss first-quarter 2026 results for GPGI (formerly CompoSecure) including pro forma figures for Husky Technologies. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special situation is announced. The dividend is a standard cash distribution with no capital-return event such as a special dividend or buyback. This is a routine current report with no special-situation event.
